concept.title: Authentication
concept.shortdesc: All Tasklytics API requests require an API key passed in the request header.

conbody.p: Your API key is generated when you create a Tasklytics developer account. You can view and regenerate your key at any time from the Developer Settings page in your account dashboard.
Include your API key in every request using the Authorization header. The value must be the word Bearer followed by a space and then your key.
